Kimzy ran as fast as she could, literally with her back feeling the presence of a ugly hungry troll who was chasing her. When she saw the ruins overgrown with vines in front of her, she deftly slid between the stones. There goblin woman ran into the ruined room, easily moving with her toned legs. She didn't notice the slightly shining runic inscriptions on the floor, covered with dust and dirt.
